title: Time-Invariant Cosmology (TIC)
content: There is not a single experiment in physics that would confirm the existence of physical time. Therefore, the idea that the universe has its origins in some distant physical past has no scientific basis. The Big Bang cosmology is based on a misunderstanding of time as a physical reality in which the universe evolves and on a misinterpretation of astronomical data. The expansion of universal space has never been directly observed. The hypothetical expansion of the universe is based on a misinterpretation of the gravitational redshift. It has never been observed that the CMB is relic radiation that propagates through physical time. CMB is the radiation of the existing universal space. In this paper, a cosmology is introduced where time does not play any role. Space is assumed to be time-invariant, while time is an emergent physical quantity, the duration of physical changes in time-invariant space, which enters existence in the process of measurement; past and future do not exist as physical realities. Time-invariant cosmology (TIC) is based on the direct reading of astronomical data. The universe is non-created and eternal. AGNs are rejuvenating systems of the universe.
